name: 01_happy_path
description: Raise of 400 units at 105 USDC, scheduled treasury releases, five quarterly reports (zero, three paid, year reset), holder claims; checks the YTD method, fees and accumulators end to end.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

steps.note: 1,000 units offered at reserve 100 USDC, min raise 20,000 USDC, defaults otherwise, 4 × 25% quarterly releases
settled: 400 units at 105 USDC; proceeds 42,000; 1% fee 420; excess escrow refunded; each bidder holds 100 units
YTD 35,000 < θ → payment 0; paid on acceptance
zero report accepted: lastPaidPeriod = 8104, nothing owed, status OnTime
paid: fee 30 → collector, 570 net → vault; paidPerUnitWad = 1.5 USDC/unit
year 2026 complete: gross 5,200 = 4% × (210,000 − 80,000); 5% fees; every holder claimed 1,235 USDC net; vault empty
new year: prior = ZERO_INCOME_COMMITMENT; below θ → 0
2027 Q1 zero report; status OnTime; releasedTotal == proceeds
